adjustments.t: Avoid high doses in the first trimester

contraindications.t: Co-administration with drugs that prolong QT and are CYP3A4 substrates

cautions.t: Inhibits CYP2C9 and 3A4: raises warfarin, phenytoin, sulfonylureas

adverse_effects.t: Nausea, abdominal pain, raised liver enzymes, QT prolongation, rash

monitoring.t: Liver function on prolonged high doses
